reason: Today's observed errors: subject-verb head subject from Firebase, plus comparison and word-form/adverb traps visible in learner screenshots. Includes a small collocation set because the current session reached that topic.

questions.stem: A list of approved vendors _____ posted on the procurement portal.
questions.explanation: The head subject is singular “A list.” The phrase “of approved vendors” only modifies “list,” so the singular verb “is” is required.
questions.explanationTh: ประธานแท้คือ “A list” ซึ่งเป็นเอกพจน์ ส่วน “of approved vendors” เป็นเพียงวลีขยาย จึงต้องใช้กริยาเอกพจน์ “is”

whyOthers.A: “are” agrees with a plural subject, but the head subject is “A list.”
whyOthers.C: “have” is both the wrong verb and plural/base agreement here.
whyOthers.D: “be” is a base form and cannot stand alone as the finite verb here.

questions.stem: The quality of the replacement parts _____ improved since last month.
questions.explanation: The head subject is singular “The quality,” not the plural noun “parts.” “Since last month” also calls for present perfect, so “has improved” is correct.
questions.explanationTh: ประธานแท้คือ “The quality” เป็นเอกพจน์ ไม่ใช่ “parts” และ since last month ต้องใช้ Present Perfect จึงเป็น “has improved”

questions.stem: Each of the new interns _____ a security badge on the first day.
questions.explanation: “Each” is the head subject and is singular, so the simple-present verb must be “receives.”
questions.explanationTh: head subject คือ “Each” ซึ่งเป็นเอกพจน์เสมอ แม้ interns จะเป็นพหูพจน์ จึงใช้ receives

questions.stem: Neither the supervisor nor the technicians _____ available this afternoon.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. “Technicians” is plural, so “are” is correct.
questions.explanationTh: neither...nor ให้กริยาตามประธานที่อยู่ใกล้ที่สุด ซึ่งคือ technicians (พหูพจน์) จึงใช้ are

questions.stem: The number of customer complaints _____ decreased this quarter.
questions.explanation: “The number” is singular, so use “has.” The present-perfect form “has decreased” also fits the current-quarter context.
questions.explanationTh: คำที่เป็นประธานแท้คือ “The number” ซึ่งเป็นเอกพจน์ จึงใช้ has และได้ Present Perfect “has decreased”

questions.stem: The new warehouse is nearly twice as large _____ the company’s previous facility.
questions.explanation: The multiplier pattern is “twice as + adjective + as.” Therefore “twice as large as” is required.
questions.explanationTh: สูตรหลายเท่าคือ “twice as + adjective + as” ดังนั้นต้องเป็น “twice as large as” ไม่ใช้ than

whyOthers.A: “than” belongs to a comparative such as “larger than,” not “twice as large than.”
whyOthers.C: “like” expresses similarity but does not close the as...as pattern.
whyOthers.D: “from” is used in phrases such as “different from,” not this equality pattern.

questions.stem: The upgraded model is considerably more reliable _____ the older version.
questions.explanation: “More reliable” is a comparative, and comparatives are followed by “than.”
questions.explanationTh: มีรูป comparative “more reliable” จึงต้องตามด้วย than

questions.stem: The online option is not as expensive _____ the printed package.
questions.explanation: The equality pattern is “not as + adjective + as.”
questions.explanationTh: โครงสร้างเทียบความเท่ากัน/ไม่เท่ากันคือ “not as + adjective + as” จึงตอบ as

questions.stem: The new distribution center is three times as large _____ the old one.
questions.explanation: After “three times as large,” the pattern closes with “as.”
questions.explanationTh: three times as large เป็นสูตรเดียวกับ twice as large จึงต้องปิดด้วย as

questions.stem: Shipping by rail is generally less expensive _____ shipping by air.
questions.explanation: “Less expensive” is a comparative structure and takes “than.”
questions.explanationTh: less + adjective เป็น comparative เช่นเดียวกับ more + adjective จึงใช้ than

questions.stem: The new inventory system processes orders more _____ than the previous one.
questions.explanation: The blank modifies the verb “processes,” so an adverb is required. “Efficiently” is the adverb.
questions.explanationTh: ช่องว่างขยายกริยา “processes” ว่าประมวลผลอย่างไร จึงต้องใช้ adverb “efficiently” ไม่ใช่ adjective “efficient”

questions.stem: The customer service team responded _____ to the complaint.
questions.explanation: The blank modifies the verb “responded,” so the adverb “professionally” is required.
questions.explanationTh: ช่องว่างขยาย responded จึงต้องตอบ adverb “professionally”

questions.stem: All safety equipment is inspected _____ before each shift.
questions.explanation: The blank modifies “is inspected,” so an adverb is required: “thoroughly.”
questions.explanationTh: คำนี้ขยายกริยา passive “is inspected” ว่าตรวจอย่างไร จึงต้องเป็น adverb “thoroughly”

questions.stem: Ms. Park explained the revised procedure _____ during orientation.
questions.explanation: “Clearly” is an adverb modifying the verb “explained.”
questions.explanationTh: ช่องว่างตอบคำถามว่า explained อย่างไร จึงต้องใช้ adverb “clearly”

questions.stem: The migration was completed _____ and ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: The adverb “successfully” modifies “was completed.”
questions.explanationTh: completed เป็นกริยา จึงต้องใช้ adverb “successfully” เพื่อบอกว่าทำสำเร็จอย่างไร

questions.stem: The company will _____ a customer survey next week.
questions.explanation: All four choices are verbs, so grammar alone is not enough. The natural collocation is “conduct a survey,” meaning carry out a survey.
questions.explanationTh: ทุกตัวเลือกเป็น verb จึงใช้ไวยากรณ์ตัดไม่ได้ ต้องดู collocation: “conduct a survey” = ดำเนินการสำรวจ ส่วน construct=ก่อสร้าง, contain=บรรจุ/ประกอบด้วย, contact=ติดต่อ

whyOthers.B: Construct means build; we construct a building, not a survey.
whyOthers.C: Contain means hold/include; a company does not contain a survey.
whyOthers.D: Contact needs a person/organization as its object; we contact a customer, not conduct a survey by saying contact a survey.

questions.stem: The retailer plans to _____ a new loyalty program in November.
questions.explanation: The business collocation is “launch a program,” meaning introduce it.
questions.explanationTh: collocation ที่ใช้จริงคือ “launch a program” = เปิดตัว/เริ่มโครงการ

questions.stem: Please _____ any technical problems to the IT help desk immediately.
questions.explanation: The natural expression is “report a problem to” a department.
questions.explanationTh: ใช้ “report a problem to + หน่วยงาน” = แจ้งปัญหาไปยังหน่วยงาน

questions.stem: The updated procedure is intended to _____ the approval process.
questions.explanation: “Streamline a process” means make it simpler and more efficient.
questions.explanationTh: “streamline a process” เป็นวลีธุรกิจ หมายถึงทำกระบวนการให้สั้น/ง่าย/มีประสิทธิภาพขึ้น

questions.stem: The supplier agreed to _____ the damaged units at no additional charge.
questions.explanation: The natural phrase is “replace damaged units.”
questions.explanationTh: collocation และความหมายที่ถูกคือ “replace damaged units” = เปลี่ยนสินค้าที่เสีย
